description: From a seeded locked PRD, a non-interactive create-trd run writes a TRD under docs/TRD/ that trd-cli parses with at least one task, gives every REQ a task and commits nothing to main. Extends the legacy create-trd scenario (same task, a REQ-NNN PRD and a constitution file in the fixture, since the Constitution Gate halts without one).
prompt:
docs/PRD/PRD-2026-b2c3d4e5-slugify.md --foreman

This is a non-interactive run: do not ask questions, choose recommended options, and write the TRD under docs/TRD/. Do not implement anything.
